title: RWB-S9-E6034-APP: the legacy story names two read endpoints and no operation that places the account, partner_instruction carries no rule-version or decision column, S9 owns no route set so the placement rule is only expressible as the D9 rows R-WO-29 to R-WO-32, the legacy permission table gives the Partner portal right R while the issue needs C and the FSD also-uses role has no matrix row, both screens are list states with no placement form, the plan C row is empty while the case and the rule package are consumed, DP-04 and DP-09 are absent, the EV-20 consumer set and payload are not published, and no requirement row traces to FEAT-PRM-06
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E6034-APP; context pack S9 rwb-partner (service row, ownership rows, naming rules, Architecture v5 slides 4, 8 and 12); legacy RWB-E6-034; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A1.1, A1.2, A1.3, A2.6, A2.6.2, A2.6.3 and A2.6.4; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T5.3, T6.1, T8 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules, Route sets and States sheets; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-PRM-06
section: Metadata (Dependencies and Patterns applied); Sections 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.3, 12.8, 13, 15 and 18
description: (1) The legacy Endpoints table of RWB-E6-034 gives two reads and no write: GET /api/recovery/v1/partners (Partner portal R) and GET /api/recovery/v1/partner/instructions (Partner portal R), while the feature places an account and the TSD publishes the write as API-S9-002 POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions. (2) No column of partner_instruction carries a rule version, a rule ID, a decision reference or the picked agency as evidence: TSD S9 T3.1 gives DF-PRT-008 to DF-PRT-016 (id, case_id, partner_id, instruction_type, instructed_at, due_at, status, result_code, fee_amount) and the FSD field catalog of A2.6.3.2 lists the same fields. (3) The routing logic carries ten route sets and none is a partner set: the placement is expressible only as the D9 rows R-WO-29, R-WO-30 and R-WO-31 of the Write-off set, whose owner column names the partner and agency manager and the outsourced agency rather than a service. (4) The legacy Permission checks table gives the Partner portal right R to eight named roles and 21 more, while API-S9-002 needs right C; and the FSD also-uses role Credit Administration officer has no row in TSD S9 T6.1. (5) The legacy screen table gives SCR-35 Placement and allocation and SCR-34 Partner list the state Loading; list, and no source describes a placement form or the place of the placement action. (6) The plan gives H = RWB-S9-E6034-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the case of rwb-case and the placement rows of rwb-decision, so two consumed rows have no plan row. (7) DP-04 is absent although the step reads a rule version, DP-09 is absent although the service owns topic rwb.partner.events.v1 and EV-20 is published, and the absent H rows RWB-PLT-E1072-CON, RWB-P7-E1073-CON and RWB-PLT-TE006-CON are recorded instead. (8) The context pack names the two events as EV-20 and EV-21 only, and TSD S9 T5.3 gives the names InstructionIssued and PartnerResultSubmitted but no payload, no field list and no consumer set. (9) TSD S9 T8 maps REQ-S9-001 to REQ-S9-009 to FEAT-PRM-01 and FEAT-PRM-08 only, so no requirement row traces to FEAT-PRM-06 and the legacy story carries no REQ id. (10) partner_user is one of the three tables the context pack gives this service, yet TSD S9 T3.1 gives it no field catalog.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-034 Endpoints, Permission checks, Screen and states, Data and Test cases; FSD S9 A2.6.2 step table and integration points, A2.6.3.1 rules VR-S9-006-1 and BR-S9-006, A2.6.3.2 field catalog, A2.6.3.3 roles Partner and agency manager primary and Credit Administration officer also uses, A2.6.4.1 AC-S9-006-01; TSD S9 T3.1 field list DF-PRT-001 to DF-PRT-016, T3.2 four lists and no other, T3.3 relationships, T5.3 events InstructionIssued and PartnerResultSubmitted, T6.1 RBAC matrix with RW-AGENCYMG CRUDA, six CRU roles, three RA roles, thirteen R roles and six PT-* identities, T8 nine REQ rows mapped to FEAT-PRM-01 and FEAT-PRM-08, T-A.1 six operations with rights and first epics, T-A.2 error set 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422 and 503; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-29, R-WO-30, R-WO-31 and R-WO-32, Route sets sheet with ten sets and no partner set, States sheet naming PLACEMENT_DECIDED a decision point and PLACED_WITH_AGENCY a partner step; context pack S9 ownership rows (3 tables, 6 REST operations, 2 events, 1 workflow, 0 jobs); split plan slice RWB-S9-E6034-APP with empty C, I and X
area: Operation coverage, field definition, route set, role mapping, screen, dependency row, event payload and requirement trace
owner_role: Solution architect; business lead; access owner in rwb-access
proposed: Keep the plan H, C, I and X rows as they stand; issue the placement through API-S9-002 and never through a new path; record the rule version and the picked agency on the local decision record and add no column to partner_instruction; read the placement rows from rwb-decision as data and record the absent DP-04 rows; read the case on the rwb-case contract and record the absent C rows; authorise the issue on the Partner portal right C the matrix gives and record the legacy right R and the missing also-uses row as conflicts; serve the placement from the list state of SCR-35 through the composite route and carry the form as a placeholder; publish EV-20 with IDs only and record the absent DP-09 row; let the trace rest on the legacy key and the feature row until the E6 BRD and the PRD publish a requirement

title: RWB-S9-E6034-CON: no source publishes the property list of InstructionRequest, of the Partner and PartnerInstruction answers or of the paged instruction answer, no message ID is published per error condition, partner_user has no field catalog, the two consumed operation names have no baseline, the plan C row is empty while the baseline declares two consumed rows, and no requirement row traces to FEAT-PRM-06
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E6034-CON; context pack S9 rwb-partner; legacy RWB-E6-034; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A1.1, A1.2, A2.6.2, A2.6.3 and A2.6.4; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T8 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; API Specification v4; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-PRM-06
description: (1) TSD S9 T-A.2 publishes the operation ids, the request element names InstructionRequest, InstructionAcceptance, the multipart result and InvoiceRequest, the answer names PartnerInstruction, InstructionPage, Invoice and Partner[], the rights and the error status codes, but no property of any element, no required flag and no message ID per condition. (2) The property list of InstructionRequest therefore has no source: the FSD field catalog of A2.6.3.2 gives field names of partner and partner_instruction, not request properties, and TSD S9 T3.1 gives columns, not an element. (3) partner_user is named in the context pack ownership rows as one of the three tables of the service, and TSD S9 T3.1 gives it no object definition, no columns and no list. (4) No source publishes the operation names of the case read of rwb-case or the placement-rule read of rwb-decision. (5) TSD S9 T8 maps every REQ-S9 row to FEAT-PRM-01 or FEAT-PRM-08, so the baseline has no requirement row to trace to and the legacy story carries no REQ id. (6) The plan C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the baseline declares two consumed rows, and DP-04 and DP-09 are absent from the pattern set although the step reads a rule version and publishes EV-20. (7) The legacy story names two read endpoints and no operation that places the account, so the baseline fixes the write operation from TSD S9 T-A.1 and records the legacy omission.
evidence: TSD S9 T-A.1 six operations with rights, first epics and idempotency rules, T-A.2 operation detail with purposes, requests, responses, error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422 and 503 and no message ids, T3.1 the two object definitions and no third, T3.2 the four lists, T3.3 the two relationships, T5.3 the two event names, T6.1 the 29 identities with their rights, T8 nine REQ rows without FEAT-PRM-06; FSD S9 A2.6.3.1 VR-S9-006-1 and BR-S9-006, A2.6.3.2 field catalog, A2.6.3.3 two roles, A2.6.4.4 no background event; context pack S9 ownership rows with 3 tables including partner_user, 6 operations and 2 events; split plan slice RWB-S9-E6034-CON with empty H, C, I and X
area: Contract surface, element properties, field catalog, interface names and requirement trace
owner_role: Solution architect; business lead; data steward
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message of section 14, declare the three operations of the key on the one base and name the other three as their stories, declare partner_user without properties, declare the case and rule rows as consumed and faked, record the decision-record and EV-20 elements, and trace to the legacy key and the feature row until the E6 BRD and the PRD publish a requirement
